physician_policy.source_boundary: only published names/levels/rank/practice adopted from source. Exact recovery, stat kind, duration/cost and single-stage scope are project choices; 九转回心 here explicitly a strong living-target heal, not asserted official resurrection. No implicit new resurrection mechanic.
physician_policy.ordinary_source_qualification: exact level/rank/practice; no additional fame/silver/book cost by explicit project choice
physician_policy.accepted_cast: validate alive/idle/compatible staff/resource/cooldown/target; snapshot current party and valid same-map/LOS/range recipients; deduct/start cooldown once
physician_policy.party_heal_selection: caster is included if eligible; explicit primary next; remaining by HP fraction ascending then distance then stable ID, maximum6 real units including NPC, not whole30raid
physician_policy.party_membership_change: at effect revalidate same actual party/instance/alive/range/LOS; never add newly joined recipients or retarget after accepted snapshot
physician_policy.recovery_formula: flat + ceil(target_max_hp_at_effect * specified basis points /10000); limit to missingHP; target maxHP must be valid not repaired
physician_policy.zero_effect_before_cast: all selected recipients full or recovery-blocked -> reject no cost; late block/death/move means skipped without refund
physician_policy.recovery_not_damage: no ordinary accuracy/crit/weapon attack/bleed/charge/offensive rage; explicit learned healing-trigger passives still require separate definitions
physician_policy.healing_block: HP recovery only, includes instant/periodic; no revive at0HP
physician_policy.buff_stacking: strongest same-family source only; two defense-buff20 sources give20 not40. Source ID/caster/remaining independently retained. Run buff multiplies ordinary walk/run mode once, then lightness family selects highest legitimate speed, not multiplication on lightness; dodge distance unchanged. Rage applied after added flat defense; weakening after rage.
physician_policy.same_source_reapply: replace duration with3600 no addition; never refresh through mere UI selection; existing cost/cooldown not reset by learning/unequip
physician_policy.lifecycle: paid standalone buff lasts original snapshot until expiry/death/explicit dispel; no recast on source save/load. World steps freeze offline/pause; LAN host commits all recipient updates with existing journal protocol
physician_policy.scope: new5 definitions plus source first heal and2lightness cover all8 physician auxiliary rows; source current runtime stages/effects remain project design, not full physician attack/passive tree

effect.existing_hostile_aggro: do not clear, no invulnerability; conceal only acquisition outside2m/valid LOS; already accepted targeted attacks remain legal

effect.direction: backward from current facing; no targeted actor swap

assassin_displacement_policy.source_boundary: original table provides names/conditions/cost-of-learning only. These exact effects, including backward archer reposition rather than target swapping and no assassin invulnerability teleport, are project adaptation; not official tooltip claims.
assassin_displacement_policy.cast_eligibility: living/idle/no incompatible hard-control/no scene switch; own class/level/rank/learned; accepted cost and cooldown once. Stealth requires out of combat; other adopted buffs/reposition allow combat if current activity allows skill.
assassin_displacement_policy.basic_speed_timing: speed multiplier applies only future normal-attack windup/recovery, ceil(original_steps*10000/multiplier), minimum1step; active hit offsets unchanged. Already accepted actions not retimed, no skill cooldown/DoT/gathering/dodge acceleration. Strongest speed family only, never multiply repeated buff.
assassin_displacement_policy.stat_buff_order: flat attack/evasion added once as a named source before respective rage/weakening or23accuracy test; same family strongest not sum; both evasion skills give at most50. Single-source reapply replaces duration, no duration addition.
assassin_displacement_policy.stealth_network: same visible ally character remains marked for party/self; hostile AI acquisition uses actual detection policy. Room chat/profile identity not hidden. No client-local invisibility pretending server has no target. Breaking concealment does not reset aggro/cooldowns.
assassin_displacement_policy.displacement: sweep current character collision along intended vector with actual navigation/water/gates/height policy; first obstruction stops at last legal position, no full-distance teleport behind wall. Precast valid movement must be>=250mm or reject without cost. At movement time new obstruction can shorten/stop, no refund. No actor swap, damage, added invulnerability or implicit primary target.
assassin_displacement_policy.interaction: movement cancels click-path and clears pending service interaction; never auto activates portal/gather/quest. Normal hostile damage still applies, geometry used for subsequent hit checks. Existing DoT continues.
assassin_displacement_policy.persistence: standalone buff/stealth source and remaining steps, cooldown; active movement action stores accepted direction, remaining travel/steps and collision position in activity snapshot. Normal save waits action end. Pause/offline freeze, LAN host commits result. Death clears transient effects, not cooldowns.
assassin_displacement_policy.other_sources: detection abilities and attack-speed passives need own explicit profiles; missing definitions never default to invulnerable/full-distance blink

remaining_auxiliary_policy.source_boundary: source provides names/conditions only; all exact numeric effects and original-style names as buffs here are project adaptations. No claim of official tooltip parity. Awakening is a temporary weapon empowerment, not summonable creature AI or permanent weapon progression.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.eligibility: correct class/level/exact declared rank/prerequisite, deduct exact listed original practice or explicit hero level1000 project cost once; no extra silver/fame/book gate. No absent-field default.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.cast: living idle and activity permits, valid weapon when declared. Pay mana/start cooldown once; paid interruption has no refund. Source state and parameters snapshot on activation. Blood devil martial zero-cost override still applies.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.stat_order: nonfamily base plus strongest flat contribution in each named family; archer stance and awakening multiply respective sources once before rage/weakening. Other effect families retain independent specific coefficients, never fold all into single rarity multiplier. Percent modifiers use per-source snapshot anchor excluding that family and all downstream rage/weakening/transfer contributions; cycles or unsupported modifier scopes fail formal configuration.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.flat_family: physician strong-tendon defense and assassin spirit-snake attack are mapped into defense_flat_aux/attack_flat_aux; same-family take strongest, source timers independent; no accumulation by recasting or rank swapping.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.stance: yin/yang are mutually exclusive per archer; accepted application replaces own old stance once, never stack positive part of both; loss from each stance applied together. Different archetypes do not borrow it from same-name effects.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.weapon_awakening: three source rows are linked forms/stages of one fire_dragon_awakening family, each still a named cast. Learn1 before2 before3; own family shared1800step cooldown, higher-stage learning/cast cannot reset an existing one. One active source per caster; replace not add. Requires actual equipped fire-dragon blade; unequip cancels weapon-bound awakening/intent, no cooldown refund. Character/weapon permanent advancement unchanged.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.mana_reduction: one strongest auxiliary reduction family; apply after explicit fixed mana cost and before blood-devil zero override, round upward, positive base minimum1, zero stays0. Does not reduceHP/stamina/items/learning fees; other learned passive reductions need declared order, not guessed.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.chord_control: music ability permits explicit one-of-three chord choice via actual cast; extends14 rule that menus alone never grant free chord. Existing chord replaced with canonical duration, no stacked triad/seventh/ninth; not modify saved custom-cycle order or bypass high-mountain cycle setting qualification.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.mana_restore: self/current real party, same map/LOS/15m, caster first then low mana fraction/distance/ID up to6; capture eligible recipient set at accept, revalidate at effect. ceil(target maxmana20percent), limit missing; no new recipients/extra mana via repeated request. All full before cast rejects. HP healing-block alone does not block mana; mana-specific blocker honored. No revive0HP. Fixed0mana cost explicit,120sec cooldown not reset by casting other ranks.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.persistence: each source/timer/shared cooldown and group recipient snapshot in full action snapshots; world-time freeze pause/offline. Switching stance/weapon/role clears only dependent effects. No item creation, permanent weapon unlock or phase completion from visual awakening.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.scope: 60source rows all have adopted local behavior in explicit subsets including initial physician source reference. Complete active official stage trees/passive trigger definitions, whole build ordering and runtime validation remain distinct unfinished work.

persistent_lightness_state.legacy_import: 四已知旧来源无活跃轻功，显式空对象；现行缺字段拒绝，不从旧移动速度推断技能或补触发。
persistent_lightness_state.identity: 仅31个lightness_definitions的ability_id作键，每技能至多一条；本人为隐含施放者/目标，来源职业由identities绑定且必须等于角色class_id。仅保存trigger_event_id与remaining_steps1..1800，不另存速度、profile、有效最强、计时起点或是否开启。
persistent_lightness_state.activation: 原施法接纳支付/启动既有冷却，完整施法原结果在实际落效时重验存活/非战斗/徒步非变身非骑乘且活动许可；成功才写对应键1800，trigger_event_id指原实际落效结果并可回溯原接纳。接纳后被打/中断/模式不符则不创建、不退款、不刷新冷却。
persistent_lightness_state.refresh: 同技能新的合法施法实际落效只替换对应原凭证并重置1800，不叠次数；同结果重放无刷新。不同已学同职业轻功各自保时长，最强实际速度从原definitions选取，其他来源不暂停；最强结束后仅余时仍正的弱源接续，无免费新1800。
persistent_lightness_state.timing: 实际生成步不扣新余时，后续世界步入口对既有来源扣1，0先移除再移动/接纳动作；暂停/离线冻结。冷却仍原character.timers，不随效果结束清零或复制到效果表。
persistent_lightness_state.termination: 本人死亡、明确取消轻功、进入不允许的运动模式/角色切换、实际受伤或合法接纳敌对施法按原定义终止本人的全部轻功来源；施法接纳失败不视为敌对施法。不是一次仅移除最强后令弱源立即恢复。角色进入受伤流程须沿原伤害结果执行清理，完整伤害类型与战斗状态规则仍引用原战斗owner。
persistent_lightness_state.navigation: 最高速度仅给正常徒步移动控制；碰撞/导航/地图门禁照常，回避距离和无敌帧不变，无飞跃水墙/瞬移。真实移动意图、轨迹与受控方向在原移动结果中保存，不复制进轻功。
persistent_lightness_state.validation: 先验完整角色/effects白名单；职业/已学/实际原落效及合法模式为语义门槛，待复活角色必须空。来源31项不补造其他职业同名轻功，当前角色未采用的技能拒绝。
persistent_lightness_state.physician_potency: 两医师轻功原落效结果必须冻结九天有效等级0..40，合法速度按原基础及九天potency一次计算；活跃表仍只存原凭证/余时，读取该原结果而非后来装备。吸星明确排除轻功，轻功时长仍1800；同族最高比较实际冻结速度，不只比较原profile。

persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.legacy_import: 四已知旧来源显式空表；现行缺字段拒绝，不从面板/武器外观补效果。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.coverage: 恰好本合同physician_definitions中2个、assassin_displacement_definitions中5个、remaining_auxiliary_definitions中13个含effect.duration_steps的定义，共20个。轻功由persistent_lightness_state，琴师和弦由职业资源，瞬时恢复与三位移由原动作结果持有，不重复计时。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.fields: 每源精确source_actor_id/source_ability_id/trigger_event_id/remaining_steps；trigger为本次真实成功落效结果，可追溯原接纳和本人接收更新。原效果系数/家族/阶段从技能定义取，原冻结有效火龙问鼎等级在该落效结果，不在来源重复保存数值/来源职业/目标/是否生效。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.identity: 每个(source_actor_id,source_ability_id)最多一源，按source_ability_id后source_actor_id稳定排序；新合法落效替换同源凭证与余时不叠加，重放原结果不刷新。医师两增益允许真实有效队友施放，其余18个来源必须本人且技能职业与本人一致，不允许用他人姿态/潜行。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.duration: 各自余时不得超过本次原落效冻结时长。一般为effect.duration_steps；医师强筋/身轻另按原吸星有效等级0..40计算floor(3600*(10000+100*grade)/10000)，最高5040；三觉醒为1800+6*原有效火龙问鼎等级0..40，最高2040。这些原等级/基础/有效总时长在实际落效原结果保存，活跃源只引用原结果与余时；正面不套负面时长修正。成功冷却仍原定义，不随时长改动。生成步不扣新余时，后续世界步入口扣旧源，0先移再行为，暂停离线冻结。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.family: 所有来源各自扣时，同命名属性家族只取最强有效贡献不加总；同量用trigger_event_id/source_actor_id/source_ability_id稳定选唯一来源。弱源不因未选中暂停或重置，最强到期仅沿其真实剩余时长接替。不同家族仍沿原stat_order，不构造全能系数。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.exclusive: 本人弓手阴阳姿态最多一个；本人三阶段火龙觉醒最多一个。新的合法成功落效才在同原结果内移除旧家族并生成新源，接纳/施法失败或中断不提前清旧。不能兼取两姿态正收益而漏负值；觉醒新学习或切阶段不重置既有家族冷却。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.weapon_lifecycle: 火龙觉醒/火龙之意要求实际装备火龙刀，卸下或换为不兼容武器同原结果清这两族，原冷却保留。其他已付独立增益不因医师换杖、施放者离队/离线/死亡、装备临时有效等级变化自动刷新或移除，沿原时长；实际接收者死亡或明确解除才按适用规则清理。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.stealth: 潜行同表保存且仅一自身来源，不另存hidden布尔。真实敌对攻击/技能接纳、实际敌伤、死亡或明确取消在原结果移除潜行，拒绝接纳不破；已存在仇恨/已接纳敌方攻击不清除、不失效。2m探测与LOS由原定义和真实世界判定，不能仅客户端隐藏。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.derived_values: 快打只影响随后新接纳普通攻击的前摇/后摇，不改已接纳动作/命中偏移/冷却；身轻如燕只乘普通步行跑速一次，再与轻功最高合法速度比较，不乘轻功或回避。御流按原费用顺序，非费用护罩/免费所有资源。所有派生都不另存最终属性副本。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.validation: 完整角色/effects白名单先验，再验来源身份/原落效/收件人/排序唯一/真实时长；待复活必须空表。医师真实队伍/距离/LOS在原落效时验证，现行队伍变化不能改写历史合法来源。完整原施法/多接收者持久结果与Godot仍需实现。
persistent_auxiliary_timed_state.physician_potency: 医师两辅助增益的九天有效等级0..40在原落效结果冻结，先按原normalized效果应用一次九天系数，再按原同族选强；来源只存原凭证，不重新读取后来装备等级。强筋平防与身轻普通跑速实际贡献从该原快照求得，不仅从静态技能基础取数；其他施放者的当前等级不能重写已付来源。
